title: Manage portfolio
subtitle: Add, view, and remove positions
deleteMessage: The position will be permanently removed from your portfolio.
deleteMessageWithName: will be permanently removed from your portfolio. Performance history is preserved.

correlations.title: Correlation & Risk
correlations.description: Pearson correlation of daily returns within your portfolio, beta and annualized volatility (σ × √252) of each position against the chosen benchmark ({benchmark}). High positive correlations between positions mean little real diversification. Beta > 1: moves more than the market. Beta < 1 or negative: moves opposite.
correlations.noData: Not enough data — at least one position with chart history is required.

health.title: Portfolio health
health.description: The overall score is a weighted sum of five sub-scores. All scores are based on Yahoo fundamentals and are transparently decomposable. Use the explanations to specifically improve weak sub-scores.

import.title: Broker CSV import
import.description: Imports buy, sell, and dividend transactions from a CSV export of your broker. Already imported rows are detected via a fingerprint reference (date + ticker + type + shares + price) and skipped as duplicates. The ticker is taken as ISIN, WKN, or Yahoo symbol depending on the broker — adjust in the transaction if Yahoo quotes don't match.
import.moreRows: ... and {count} more rows (all will be imported).

brokerHints.comdirect: Transaction export (semicolon CSV) with columns Geschäftstag, WKN/ISIN, Stück, Ausführungskurs, Kurswert, Provision
brokerHints.tradeRepublic: CSV with date, type, ISIN/name, shares, price, fees, currency
brokerHints.ibkr: Flex query export of the Trades section (Symbol, Quantity, TradePrice, TradeDate, Buy/Sell, Currency, Commission)
brokerHints.generic: Header: date;ticker;type(buy|sell|dividend);shares;price;currency;fees;notes — DE numbers and date DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD

metrics.title: Performance metrics
metrics.description: Time-Weighted Return (TWR) eliminates the influence of deposits/withdrawals — so you compare pure investment performance, not cash flow size. Sharpe/Sortino measure excess return per unit of risk (Sortino only penalizes negative volatility). Calculated from daily portfolio snapshots; first values after ≥ 2 cron runs at 23:55 UTC.

report.title: Portfolio report
report.printHint: Print-optimized version of your portfolio. In the browser print dialog choose "Save as PDF". Only the content below will be printed — the app navigation is hidden.
report.footer: Automatically generated by AI Stock Analyzer. Not investment advice. For tax purposes use your broker's annual tax statement.

risk.title: Portfolio risk
risk.description: Risk metrics are based on weighted daily portfolio returns of up to the last five years. Historical values are not a reliable indicator of the future — use the numbers as reference, not as a forecast.
risk.loading: Loading price data and computing scenarios — may take 20-40 seconds...
risk.missingHistory: For these tickers there was insufficient price history available and they were excluded from the calculation: {tickers}
risk.factorDescription: Each position is normalized to five factors (0–100, 50 = neutral). Weighted aggregation onto the portfolio. Deviations from 50 show the style tilt. Calculated from Yahoo fundamentals — simplified compared to Fama-French regressions.
risk.varNotEnough: Too few common observations — at least 30 trading days with price history for all positions are needed.
risk.varBasis: Basis: {observations} observation days, empirical quantile. Interpretation: With {confidence}% probability you will not lose more than this fraction of the portfolio value on a single day.
risk.mcDescription: Historical bootstrap: random draws from observed daily returns instead of a normal distribution. This represents fat tails more realistically.
risk.stressDescription: Application of historical ticker returns from the respective crisis to your current weights. Positions without history in the period are skipped (old IPOs etc.).
